text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you describe the specific nature of your gait and limb ataxia, and when did these symptoms first begin?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned the clumsiness is especially on the right side; is this a new symptom, or have you had previous neurological issues? I also need to know if you have experienced any recent head trauma or have a history of cancer.

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and natalizumab use, I am concerned about Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). Have you experienced any recent cognitive changes, vision problems, or weakness, and do you have any known risk factors for JC virus infection? REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI Brain shows multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement, consistent with Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML).

speaker: Doctor
text:
The MRI findings are consistent with Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) given your history of natalizumab use. I will discontinue the natalizumab immediately and initiate plasmapheresis to clear the drug from your system.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML)
